verdict.rationale: Phaser Editor ships an official MCP server documented at phaser.io/agent/mcp with 40+ specialized tools integrating with Claude Desktop, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, letting agents create/edit scenes, particle emitters, layers, filters, and objects via natural language commands. This directly matches the story of programmatic, documented editor control by an agent. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the MCP tools reliably perform build/publish actions, and a full enumerated tool list/spec beyond marketing copy.
